question: Where can I get a list of stand-alone battery storage (BESS) projects currently in permitting in Australia, with location, power (MW), developer, permitting stage and date?

answer.summary: There is no single national list. Best official sources: the NSW Major Projects register (102 stand-alone BESS cases across stages with stage, LGA, address, map point, MW in text, decision date once determined) and the national EPBC referrals ArcGIS layer (104 battery-named federal referrals across stages with polygon, state and federal stage). Other states differ: WA's DAP list and VIC permit pages give stage, dates and applicant; QLD and SA lists are script-rendered and refuse automated clients. Developer and open-stage dates are mostly inside PDFs. AEMO's NEM xlsx helps discovery but its commitment status is not a permit stage.
main_caveats: Federal EPBC referral status is a separate environmental process: a 'Completed' referral says nothing about state development consent, and many BESS are never referred.
MW basis differs between sources: grid export, installed rating and AEMO AC nameplate (Wattle Creek: 350 MW export, up to 516 MW rating, 372.6 MW AC).
Hybrids: QLD assesses BESS ancillary to wind/solar inside that application; NSW splits hubs into separate cases; WA's list mixes both. Filter by description.
VIC, QLD, SA and TAS planning sites and the NT EPA register answered 403 to automated clients on 2026-11-26; VIC was read only through archived copies.
AEMO commitment status is not a permit stage: Tramway Road (VIC permit 31/10/2025) is still 'Publicly Announced' in the October 2026 release.
answer.confidence_reason: NSW, EPBC, WA, ACT and AEMO were tested by query or document; QLD and SA rows could not be read (403/script), so coverage outside NSW is partial.

attributes.note: NSW address and map point; EPBC referral polygon; WA/VIC/ACT addresses or lots. Precision: street address or lot, polygon is the referral area.
attributes.gap_note: QLD SARA and SA PlanSA rows not readable (403/script); council-level DAs outside NSW sampled only in TAS and NT.

attributes.note: MW only in free text or documents (NSW description, EPBC description, WA/ACT reports); AEMO gives MW AC per unit for the NEM. Basis varies.
attributes.gap_note: WA DAP list gives cost not MW (MW only in each agenda report); VIC permit pages often omit MW; QLD/SA not read.

attributes.note: Proponent on EPBC pages; NSW applicant in letters/notices; VIC/WA applicant often a consultant; AEMO site owner. Mostly SPV names.
attributes.gap_note: No structured developer field in any planning register; QLD/SA applicants not read.

attributes.note: NSW stage per case; WA current vs determined lists; VIC decision field; ACT approval notices; EPBC federal stage kept separate.
attributes.gap_note: QLD SARA and SA lists unreadable to automated clients; TAS/NT have no state BESS list (council samples empty).

attributes.note: NSW Determination Date once decided, open stages only via document dates; WA received/meeting dates; VIC received/notice/decision dates.
attributes.gap_note: EPBC layer gives year only; EPBC notice dates load by script; QLD/SA not read.

sources.name: NSW Planning Portal - Major Projects register (State Significant Development / Infrastructure)
sources.publisher: NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure (DPHI)
sources.format: HTML pages (Drupal view with GET filters); per-folder document lists as JSON; documents as PDF
sources.summary: NSW register of State Significant projects; filter development types 'Electricity generation - Other' and 'Electricity Supply' to list BESS cases with stage, LGA, address and MW text.
sources.coverage_note: NSW only; 102 stand-alone BESS cases on 2026-11-26 (25 determined, 8 withdrawn, rest in SEARs to Assessment).
caveats: Two development types must be queried.

problems: No bulk export or documented API for this register found; the list is paged HTML.
Applicant and open-stage dates are not structured fields.

sources.summary: National ArcGIS layer of EPBC referrals; filter NAME for BATTERY/BESS to get federal environmental cases with polygon, state, federal status/stage and year.

No proponent, MW or exact dates.

members_summary.scope_note: Seven states/territories other than NSW (NSW is source nsw-major-projects); one register opened per jurisdiction; readable BESS rows in WA, VIC (archived) and ACT.
members_summary.pattern: Look for the state assessment body's 'current applications', 'ministerial permits' or 'notified developments' page; large BESS go to a state pathway (VIC DFP, QLD SARA, WA DAP/SDA, SA SCAP), small ones to councils.

sources.name: EPBC Act Public Portal - referral summary pages
sources.publisher: Australian Government, National Environmental Protection Agency (EPBC Act Public Portal)
sources.format: HTML (Microsoft Power Pages); list grids loaded by script
sources.summary: Referral summary page per EPBC number: proponent, address and MW/MWh in the description; open it with the CRM_ID from the ArcGIS layer.
sources.coverage_note: All EPBC referrals; tested on 2024/09970 (Wattle Creek).
caveats: No dates in the server HTML.
Proponent is often a project SPV.

problems: List and notice grids need a script-issued request with an anti-forgery token; no static list or export without it.

sources.name: AEMO NEM Generation Information (October 2026 release, xlsx)
sources.summary: Quarterly NEM xlsx of proposed and committed projects; 655 battery units with owner, MW AC, MWh and commitment status; use to discover and cross-check, not as permit stage.
sources.coverage_note: NEM only (no WA, NT); October 2026 release; 436 battery-only sites not yet in service.
caveats: Commitment status is not a planning stage.

problems: Landing page rejects automated clients (403 challenge); description read from a web.archive.org copy of 2026-11-14.

if_unstructured.summary: Developer, MW and stage dates are mostly only in planning documents: NSW case PDFs, WA DAP agenda reports, VIC permit pages and ACT approval notices.
